info.cls_name: 工程與科學學院綜合班

description.describe_ch: 本課程為修習微積分前的先導課程，內容涵蓋基礎函數(多項式、根式、三角、指對數等函數)、代數運算、幾何概念、數列與級數等先備知識。
description.describe_eh: This course is an introductory course before taking calculus. The content covers basic functions (polynomials, radicals, trigonometric, exponential and logarithmic functions), algebraic operations, geometric concepts, sequence and series and other prior knowledge.

targets.describe_en: Review the basic concepts of functions

targets.describe_ch: 熟悉多項式、對數、指數、三角等函數之相關概念與性質
targets.describe_en: Familiar with related concepts and properties of polynomial, logarithmic, exponential, trigonometric and other functions

targets.describe_ch: 清楚函數之間的代數運算及合成
直線、平面、圓形及圓錐曲線等各類方程式之複習
targets.describe_en: Review of various equations such as straight lines, planes, circles and conic sections

targets.describe_ch: 複習數列與級數的概念
targets.describe_en: Review the concepts of sequences and series
